answer: Latency-Trellis Admission Gate. Each identity must submit its first N requests as an unbroken chain of inter-arrival gaps drawn from a narrow, published distribution; the gate holds arrivals in a saffron-flagged buffer and scores shape divergence until the chain completes. Sybils minted in bulk arrive as near-simultaneous bursts or uniform timers, failing the shape test and getting throttled. Honest agents pay only a short warm-up delay; each fake identity costs a separately timed, walnut-paced request schedule,
